Basics Sub-GHz

Sub-GHz

The Sub-GHz module receives and transmits on frequencies from 300 to 928 MHz, which covers garage door remotes, barriers, wireless doorbells and many weather stations.

Frequency bands

The supported bands are 300 to 348 MHz, 387 to 464 MHz and 779 to 928 MHz. Which of them may be used to transmit depends on the region the device is set to.

Saving captures

A received signal can be saved to the SD card, read back later and decoded when its protocol is known; unknown signals are kept as raw recordings.
